notifications.name: 4000 4 in 1
notifications.danger: The product has an excessive amount of nicotine-containing liquid (declared value: 8 ml), within the four 2ml pods. This can lead to accidental consumption of a high dose of nicotine. Nicotine is acutely toxic and may endanger the safety of the user, especially if the product comes into contact with the skin or is ingested.Furthermore, vaping from two pods simultaneously results in the inhalation of a mixture of substances that may interact in unknown ways. The potential effects of such chemical interactions on the lungs have not been assessed, posing an additional health risk. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Tobacco Products Directive.
